seo.summary: Free puzzle games to wake up your brain
seo.intro: Puzzle Garden is a collection of free brain puzzle games you can play anytime, anywhere. Sudoku, Spot the Difference (SnapSpot), Queens and jigsaws — no install, just play in your browser.

sudoku.title: 🔢 Sudoku
sudoku.body: The classic logic puzzle: fill a 9×9 grid with the numbers 1 to 9. From gentle beginner boards to tough expert stages, there's always a next challenge. A daily Sudoku habit is great for focus and logical thinking.

wordSort.title: 🃏 Word Stack
wordSort.body: A word card game where you drag cards to group words by theme.

queens.title: 👑 Crown Quest
queens.body: A logic placement puzzle: place exactly one queen in each colored region, one per row and column, and no two queens touching — not even diagonally. Simple rules, surprisingly deep thinking.

crossMath.title: ➕ Crossum
crossMath.body: A math crossword where you fill blanks in intersecting equations with number tiles.

benefits.title: Why puzzles are good for you
benefits.body: Puzzles are more than just fun — they're a real workout for your brain. Studies link them to better focus, sharper short-term memory and less stress. Puzzle Garden's games are designed to give your brain a quick, effective boost, even in a few spare minutes.
